boundary._match: enter the paper only for T <= 500

contamination._match: contamination of the calibration sample by in-scope queries (0, 1, 5, 20 percent

crossed_bootstrap._match: crossed bootstrap over calibration draws and units (2000 resamples)

duplicates._match: contains 25 rows that duplicate REPAIR queries

e1._match: ain comparison at a matched false-firing budget** (primary logs + working points). alpha in {0.01, 0.02, 0.05, 0.10, 0.20}, n = 200, 20 random calibration draws

e2._match: **E2 Evidence curves** (primary logs). Held-out D1 rate, Rel / T-Gen / I-Gen versus the amount of evidence n in {1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 50, 100, all}

e2_switch._match: while n < 40, and switches to the two-block rule at alpha = 0.05 from n = 40 on

e5c._match: empirical false-firing rate versus alpha for n in {20, 50, 100, 200, 500}, 500 draws

e9._match: revocation sets R of m in {1, 5, 10, 20, 50} edits

h1._match: nly thresholds) against the best linear repair of the same complaints; it "helps" if D1 is at most 10 percent with Rel exact within 2 points of the deployed log

h3._match: ldout_disjoint. Decision rule for the text: "dominates" only if ReScope exceeds the best gate of the cosine family by at least 10 points of H3 on both backbones

later_edits._match: stream position >= 500 for Qwen, >= 100 for LLaVA

logonly_rule._match: Thresholds: log-only rule (5 % above the largest coordinate on the other logged sequences)

prefixes._match: Prefix logs of the two development streams after 10, 20 and 50 edits

r19_e1._match: (a) E1: behaviour at alpha = 0.05 for calibration draws 0 to 2

r22_diag._match: under the deployed model (two forward passes per tuple)

r22_min._match: For every relation r with at least 20 tuples: the selection view

r22_view._match: any run: (a) *Relation.* Facts(subject, relation, value) over a finite set of records D: the requests of the log (edited tuples) and a VIEW pool of 5000 records

ridges._match: the same stream at ridge l2 = 10, 3, 1 |

synthetic_scale._match: E8 adds synthetic logs with T up to 100000

text_decode._match: the pre-edit greedy continuation of 10 tokens is not reproduced

text_equal_evidence._match: Equal evidence, n in {1, 10, 100} reported D1 complaints

text_split._match: The split position is 173, from the audit
